Why are your prices so low?

ooShirts was founded in 2007 with an investment of just $2000. From our founding, we had to be careful with our spending -- every dollar meant a lot to us.

In our effort to be frugal, we learned that the reason t-shirts cost so much isn't because it's expensive to print a t-shirt -- it's because most printing businesses have huge profit margins. And since nearly all printing companies charge high markups, people have become accustomed to paying more.

Our mission is to change this. Despite the opportunity to make more money, we would rather charge fair prices to more customers than charge inflated prices to fewer customers. Now, even as our shirts have reached the hands of millions, we will continue to hold the same principles that have brought us this far.

To learn more, visit our story.

Style and color of garment
Number of colors in the design
Quantity and sizes

Reduce the number of colors or print locations in your design
Choose a less expensive garment
Order a white or natural colored garment
Order more garments to reduce the per unit price

Frequently Asked Questions About DTG Print
What Is DTG Print?

DTG stands for direct-to-garment. It is a printing method that sprays ink directly onto the fabric using specialized inkjet printers. This allows for full-color, high-detail prints with a soft feel and no minimum order.

What is the Minimum Order for DTG Printing?

There is no minimum order for DTG printing. You can order as few as one shirt. This makes DTG ideal for samples, small runs, and individual custom pieces.

How Many Colors Can DTG Print?

DTG can print unlimited colors in a single pass, including photographic images, gradients, and fine details. There is no extra charge for additional colors.

How Long Does DTG Printing Take?

Standard DTG orders are produced and shipped within 7 business days with free shipping. Rush delivery (5 days, +25%) and super-rush delivery (3 days, +50%) are available.

Does DTG Print Fade or Crack?

No. DTG prints use high-quality water-based inks that are absorbed into the fabric. When properly cared for, DTG prints remain vibrant and crack-free through many wash cycles.

What Shirt Styles Work With DTG?

DTG works best on 100% cotton and cotton-dominant blends. We offer a wide range of compatible styles including t-shirts, hoodies, sweatshirts, and tank tops from top brands.

Can I Print a Sample Before Ordering in Bulk?

Yes. With no minimum order, you can print a single sample to check the quality, colors, and fit before placing a larger order.

How Much Does DTG Printing Cost?

DTG pricing depends on the shirt style and quantity. Every order includes free setup, free shipping, and free design review. Use our instant pricing tool for an exact quote. Prices are 30-50% below competitors.
